Model Formula

Fitting function: glmmTMB

Error structure / family: gaussian(link = "identity")

Estimation method: ML

Formula:

log10_Biomass ~ Method + log10(Chl) + ns(Bathy, df = 2) + harmonic(HarmDOY, 
    k = 1) + Mesh + harmonic(HarmTOD, k = 1) * Depth_decay + 
    (1 | Gear)
